# CartNOW Full System Documentation

> CartNOW is an advanced, full-stack e-commerce ecosystem built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, MongoDB, and Socket.io.

## Architecture Overview

CartNOW provides an end-to-end shopping experience featuring:
1. Buyer Storefront: Browse products, manage wishlist, apply coupons, perform AI voice search, and place orders.
2. Seller Portal: Inventory management, sales analytics, and order fulfillment.
3. Logistics Fleet: Real-time rider tracking, delivery assignments, and fulfillment updates.

## API Documentation

- `GET /api/product/list`: Fetch published catalog items.
- `GET /api/product/brands`: Retrieve active seller brands and product totals.
- `POST /api/user/login`: User authentication endpoint.
- `POST /api/order/place`: Order creation and checkout processing.
